name: Lake St. Louis (United States)
description: Quartered blue and green by a white cross, the two blue quarters for the city's two lakes, charged with a yellow fleur-de-lis.
history: Lake St. Louis is a planned community and suburb of greater St. Louis, situated around two lakes between Interstate 70 and Interstate 64 in western St. Charles County, Missouri. The flag was adopted on 21 March 2022 (designed by resident Josh Buell and adopted on 21 March 2022, replacing an unofficial logo flag, according to Flags of the World citing the city's release).
